name: SeeSomething_4
short_caption: The robot looks down in surprise and places its hands on its hips, then relaxes its left arm.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture, then quickly tilts its head down and brings both hands up to rest on its hips as if startled or inspecting something close. It holds this inquisitive, hands-on-hips pose for a few seconds while looking slightly downward. Finally, it raises its head back to a neutral position and relaxes its left arm back to its side while keeping its right hand resting on its hip.
safety_notes: The robot's elbows flare out to the sides when placing hands on hips, requiring clearance on both sides.
